# labels_accessible_adjacent_to_inaccessible_via_rag { #mofography.raspa_helper.labels_accessible_adjacent_to_inaccessible_via_rag }

```python
raspa_helper.labels_accessible_adjacent_to_inaccessible_via_rag(
    results,
    percolated_labels,
    inaccessible_labels,
)
```

Region labels that are **percolating** and share an **internal** RAG edge
with at least one **inaccessible** label.

Uses :func:`mofography.compute.rag_from_connections` (same window graph as
visualization / pocket connectivity), not 6-neighbor grid adjacency.
